Hausa: Wannan ya kasance don ganin ko waɗannan kyamarori za su iya taimaka wa manoma na gida su kare amfanin gonakinsu daga giwaye.
Northern Sotho: Se e bile go bona ge eba dikhamera tše di ka thuša balemi ba kgauswi go šireetva dibjalo tša bona go ditlou.
Amharic: ይህ የሆነው እነዚህ ካሜራዎች የአካባቢው ገበሬዎች ሰብላቸውን ከዝሆኖች ለመከላከል ይረዱ እንደሆነ ለማየት ነው።

English: Their cameras could take about 17 photos a day, for about 3 months, before they needed to replace the batteries.
Luganda: Kkamera zaabwe zaali zisobola okukuba ebifaananyi nga 17 olunaku, okumala emyezi 3, nga tekinnabeetaagisa kukyusa manda.
Yoruba: Àwọn kámẹ́rà wọn le è ya fọ́tò 17 ní ọjọ́ kan fún bíi oṣù 3, kí ó tó di pé wọ́n máa nílò pípààrọ̀.
Zulu: Amakhamera abo angathatha izithombe ezingaba ngu-17 ngosuku, cishe izinyanga ezi-3, ngaphambi kokuba ashintshe amalahle.
Hausa: Kyamararsu tana iya ɗaukar hotuna kusan guda 17 a rana, na kusan kimanin watanni 3, kafin su buƙaci maye gurbin batura.
Northern Sotho: Dikhamera tša bona di be di kgona go tšea diswantšho tše di ka bago tše 17 ka letšatši, mo dikgweding tše 3, pele ga ge ba ka swanela ke go tsenya dipeteri tše dingwe.
Amharic: ካሜራዎቻቸው ባትሪዎችን ለመተካት ከመፈለጋቸው በፊት፣ ለ 3 ወራት ያህል፣ በቀን እስከ 17 ፎቶዎችን ማንሳት ይችላሉ።

English: They received alerts about 7 minutes after the camera took the photo.
Luganda: Baafuna obubaka nga wayiseewo edakiika nga 7 nga kkamera emaze okukuba ekifaananyi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n gba àtẹ̀ránṣẹ́ láyìn ìṣẹ́jú 7 ti kámẹ́rà bá ti ya fọ́tò.
Zulu: Bathole izexwayiso cishe imizuzu eyi-7 ngemuva kokuthi ikhamera ithathe isithombe.
Hausa: Sun sami sanarwa kusan mintuna 7 bayan kyamarar ta ɗauki hoton.
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše ditemošo mo metsotsong ye e ka bago ye 7 ka morago ga ge khamera e tšere seswantšho.
Amharic: ካሜራው ፎቶውን ካነሳ ከ7 ደቂቃ በኋላ ማንቂያዎችን ተቀብለዋል።

English: With some adjustments, the camera improved from correctly detecting elephants 84% of the time, to 98% of the time.
Luganda: Oluvannyuma lw’okukolamu ennongoosereza, kkamera yayongera okulongooka mu kuteebereza obulungi enjovu emirundi egikola ebitundu 84% okutuuka ku mirundi egikola ebitundu 98%.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àwọn àtúnṣẹ díẹ̀díẹ̀, kámẹ́rà yìí gbèrú láti orí rírí erin dájú ṣáká ní ìdá 84% ìgbà sí ìdá 98%.
Zulu: Ngokulungiswa okuthile, ikhamera yaba ngcono isuka ekutholeni izindlovu ngendlela efanele u-84% wesikhathi, yaya ku-98% wesikhathi.
Hausa: Tare da wasu gyare-gyare, kyamarar ta inganta daga gano giwaye daidai kashi 84% na lokacin, zuwa kashi 98% na lokaci.
Northern Sotho: Ka dipeakanyo tše dingwe, khamera e ile ya kaonafala go tseba ditlou ka 84% ya nako, go fihla go 98% ya nako.
Amharic: በአንዳንድ ማስተካከያዎች፣ ካሜራው 84% ያክል ጊዜ ዝሆኖችን በትክክል ከመለየት፣ ወደ 98% ያክል ጊዜ ተሻሽሏል።

English: The researchers hoped that making their designs and reasoning available for others to access (open access) would help improve their camera through further research.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasuubira nti okuteekawo omusono gwabwe n’amagezi gaabwe okuba nga n’abalala basobola okubifuna (kyere) kijja kuyambako okulongoosa mu kkamera yaabwe okuyita mu kunoonyereza okulala okukolebwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwádìí ní ìrètí pé ṣíṣe àgbékàlẹ iṣẹ́ tiwọn, àti èrò wọn kí ó wà ní àrówọ́tó àwọn yokù (ohun tí ó wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó) máa ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìmúgbèrú kámẹ́rà wọ́n nípasẹ iṣẹ́ ìwádìí síwájú síi.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babenethemba lokuthi ukwenza imiklamo yabo nokucabanga kutholakale ukuze abanye bakufinyelele (ukufinyelela okuvulekile) kuzosiza ukuthuthukisa ikhamera yabo ngocwaningo olwengeziwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi fatan cewa samar da zane-zane da kuma tunaninsu don samun dama ga wasu (buɗaɗɗen mashiga) zai taimaka wajen inganta kyamararsu ta hanyar ƙarin bincike..
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba be ba holofela gore go dira ditlhamo tša bona le go ba le mabaka a gore ba bangwe ba fihlelele (phihlelelo ya phatlalatša) go ka thuša go kaonafatša khamera ya bona go dira dinyakišišo go tšwela pele.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ለሌሎች ዲዛይኖቻቸውን እና ምክንያቶቻቸውን ተደራሽ በማድረግ (ማንም በነጻ የሚያየው) ካሜራቸው በተጨማሪ ምርምር ለማሻሻል ይረዳል ብለው ተስፋ አድርገዋል።

English: Other researchers had previously developed similar technology for detecting penguins and lions, but this study looking at elephants specifically had several unique, new challenges to solve.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza abalala gye buvuddeko baali baakulaakulanya dda tekinologiya ayambako okuzuula ppingu n’emplogoma, naye okunoonyereza kuno okwassa essira ku njovu kwalina okusoomooza okw’enjawulo era okupya kwe kwalina okugonjoola.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí ti ṣẹ̀dá àwọn ẹ̀rọ tó jọ báyìí tẹ́lẹ̀ fún ṣíṣèdámọ̀ pẹngúíìnì àti kìnìún, ṣùgbọ́n ìwádìí yìí ṣe àyẹ̀wo àwọn erin ní pàtó pẹ̀lú àwọn ohunj ìdáyàsọ́tọ̀ wọn, ìdojúkọ tuntun láti yanjú.
Zulu: Abanye abacwaningi bake basungula ubuchwepheshe obufanayo bokuthola amaphengwini namabhubesi, kodwa lolu cwaningo olubheka izindlovu lunezinselelo ezimbalwa ezihlukile, ezintsha okufanele zixazululwe.
Hausa: Sauran masu bincike a baya sun ƙirƙira irin wannan fasaha don gano penguins da zakuna, amma wannan binciken na kallon giwaye yana da abubuwa da yawa na musamman, sababbin ƙalubale don warwarewa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba bangwe mo nakong ye e fetilego ba hlamile theknolotši ya go swana le ye go ya tseba diphenkhwini le ditau, eupša dinyakišišo tše di lebeletše ditlou di bile le ditlhohlo tše diswa tše mmalwa tša go swana di nnoši go ka rarollwa.
Amharic: ሌሎች ተመራማሪዎች ቀደም ሲል ፔንግዊኖችን እና አንበሶችን ለመለየት ተመሳሳይ ቴክኖሎጂ ሠርተዋል፣ ነገር ግን ዝሆኖችን የሚመለከተው ይህ ጥናት፣ ልዩ የሆኑ በርካታ አዳዲስ ተግዳሮቶች ነበሩት።

English: For instance, the dense tree cover made it difficult to install the cameras where they could connect to the ISN and get enough sunlight to charge (using solar power).
Luganda: Okugeza, emiti egy’enzigotta gyakifuula kizibu okuteeka kamera we zaali zisobola okuyunga ku ISN era we zisobola okufuna ekitangaala ekimala okuzzaako omuliro (nga zikozesa amaanyi g’enjuba).
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn igi ńlá jẹ́ kó nira láti ṣe ìgbékalẹ̀ àwọn kámẹ́rà ní àwọn ibi tí wọ́n lè ti kọ̀nẹ́ẹ̀tì sí ISN kí wọ́n sì ní ààyè sí òrùn tó tó láti sáàjì (nípa lílo iná ajẹmórùn).
Zulu: Isibonelo, ikhava yesihlahla esiminyene yenze kwaba nzima ukufaka amakhamera lapho ayekwazi ukuxhuma khona ku-ISN futhi athole ukukhanya kwelanga okwanele ukuze ashaje (kusetshenziswa amandla elanga).
Hausa: Alal misali, murfin bishiyar ya sa wahala rshigar da kyamarori inda za su iya haɗi da ISN kuma su sami isasshen hasken rana domin caji (ta amfani da wutar hasken rana).
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala, go tlala ga mehlala kudu go dirile gore go be boima go bea dikhamera fao di ka kgonago kgo kgokagana le ISN le go hwetša seetša seo se lekanego go ka tšhatšhiša (ka go šomiša peteri ya sola).
Amharic: ለምሳሌ፣ ጥቅጥቅ ያለ የዛፍ ሽፋን ካሜራዎቹን ከአይኤስኤን ጋር የሚገናኙበት ለመጫን እና ቻርጅ ለማድረግ በቂ የፀሐይ ብርሃን (በፀሐይ ኃይል በመጠቀም) የሚያገኙበትን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል።

English: The temperature and humidity also interfered with some of the charging circuits.
Luganda: Ebbugumu n’amazzi g’omu bbanga agatalabika nabyo byataataaganya ebitundu ebiyamba okuzzaako omuliro.
Yoruba: Ìgbóná-gbooru àti ọ̀mìnì náà dásí ọ̀kọ̀òkan lára àwọn ẹ̀rọ afinására-ẹ̀rọ.
Zulu: Izinga lokushisa nomswakama nakho kuphazamise amanye amasekhethi okushaja.
Hausa: Haka nan yanayin zafi da laima sun shiga tsakani da wasu na'urorin caji.
Northern Sotho: Thempheretšha le monolana le tšona di ile tša šitiša go tšhatšhiša ga disekete.
Amharic: የሙቀት መጠኑ እና እርጥበጡ በአንዳንድ የኃይል መሙያ ዑደቶች ላይ ጣልቃ ገብቷል።

English: The researchers said that some branches that looked like elephant trunks caused the camera to make mistakes as well.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti amatabi g’emiti agamu agaali geefaanaanyiriza ng’obukono bw’enjovu nago gaaleetera kkamera okukola ensobi.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ẹ̀ka tọ́ rí bí i ìwo erin ń mú kí àwọn kámẹ́rà náà máa ṣe àṣìṣe.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi amanye amagatsha abukeka njengemiboko yendlovu adala ukuthi ikhamera yenze amaphutha nawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wasu rassan da suka yi kama da kututturen giwaye sun sa kyamarar ta yi kuskure kuma.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dithabe tše dingwe tša mehlare tšeo di bego di lebelelega go swana le dipogo tša mehlare di ile tša baka gore khamera go dira diphošo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ አንዳንድ የዝሆን ግንድ የሚመስሉ ቅርንጫፎች ካሜራው እንዲሳሳት ምክንያት ሆነዋል ብለዋል።

English: They were able to fix some of these issues, but they suggested that future studies should improve the AI program, use microphones, and figure out how to send low-cost images along with text alerts.
Luganda: Baasobola okutereeza ezimu ku nsonga zino, naye baateesa nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kulongoose pulogulaamu ya AI, kukozese obuzindaalo, awamu n’okulaba engeri y’okusindikamu ebifaananyi eby’ebbeeyi eya wansi ne bigendera wamu n’obubaka obuwandiike.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe díẹ̀ lára àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ náà, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n dábàá pé àwọn ẹ̀kọ∫́ ọjọ́ọwájú gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe ìfikún sí èto AI, ìlo agbóhùnsáfẹ́fẹ́, àti kí wọ́n wá ọ̀nà láti máa ṣe ìfiránṣẹ́ àwọn àwòrán kékèké pèlú àwọn àtẹ̀jíṣẹ́.
Zulu: Bakwazi ukulungisa ezinye zalezi zinkinga, kodwa baphakamisa ukuthi izifundo zesikhathi esizayo kufanele zithuthukise uhlelo lwe-AI, zisebenzise imibhobho, futhi zibone ukuthi zithunyelwa kanjani izithombe ezingabizi kakhulu kanye nezixwayiso zombhalo.
Hausa: Sun sami damar gyara wasu daga cikin waɗannan matsaloli amma sun bayar da shawarar cewa bincike na gaba ya kamata ya inganta shirin AI, amfani da makarufo, da kuma gano yadda za a aika hotuna masu rahusa tare da faɗakarwar rubutu.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba kgona go lokiša a mangwe a mathata a, eupša ba ile ba šišinya gore dinyakišišo tša ka moso di swanetše go kaonafatša lenaneo la AI, go šomiša dimaekherofoune, le go tseba ka fao go ka romelwago diswantšho tša tshenyegelo ya fase gotee le ditemošo tša go ngwalwa.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ጉዳዮች መካከል አንዳንዶቹን ማስተካከል ችለዋል፣ ነገር ግን ወደፊት የሚደረጉ ጥናቶች የኤአይአይ ፕሮግራምን ማሻሻል፣ መቅረጸብ ድምጽን መጠቀም፣ እና አነስተኛ ዋጋ ያላቸውን ምስሎች ከጽሑፍ ማንቂያዎች ጋር እንዴት እንደሚላኩ ጠቁመዋል።

English: These researchers were from Gabon, South Africa, the UK, the Netherlands, Poland, and the USA.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza bano baali bava mu Gabon, South Africa, UK, Budaaki, Poland, ne USA.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí yìí wá láti Gabon, South Africa, UK, Netherlands, Poland, àti USA.
Zulu: Laba bacwaningi bebeqhamuka eGabon, eNingizimu Afrika, e-UK, eNetherlands, ePoland nase-USA.
Hausa: Waɗannan masu binciken sun fito ne daga ƙasashen Gabon da Afirka ta Kudu da UK da Netherlands da Poland da kuma USA.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba ba be ba etšwa Gabon, Afrika Borwa, UK, Netherlands, Poland, le USA.
Amharic: እነዚህ ተመራማሪዎች ከጋቦን፣ ከደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ከእንግሊዝ፣ ከኔዘርላንድስ፣ ከፖላንድ እና ከአሜሪካ ናቸው።

English: They focused on a forest in Gabon that may be similar to other African forests, so they hope the technology can be applied elsewhere too.
Luganda: Essira baalissa ku kibira ekiri mu ggwanga lya Gabon ekiyinza okuba nga kifaanana n’ebibira ebirala ebisangibwa mu Afirika, noolwekyo basuubira nti tekinologiya asobola okukozesebwa ne mu bitundu ebirala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìfojúsùn sórí igbó kan ní Gabon tó lè jọ àwọn igbó Afíríkà mìíràn, nítorí náà wọ́n lérò pé àwọn ẹ̀rọ náà yóò lè di lílò káàkiri àwọn agbègbè mìíràn.
Zulu: Bagxile ehlathini laseGabon elingase lifane namanye amahlathi ase-Afrika, ngakho bathemba ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bungasetshenziswa nakwezinye izindawo.
Hausa: Sun mayar da hankali a kan wani daji a Gabon wanda zai yi kama da sauran dazuzzukan Afirka, don haka suna fatan za a iya amfani da fasahar a wani wuri ma.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba nepiša kudu sethokgwa sa ka Gabon seo s eka swanago le dithokgwa tša Afrika, ka fao ba holofela gore theknolotši e ka dirišwa le go gongwe.
Amharic: ከሌሎች የአፍሪካ ደኖች ጋር ሊመሳሰል በሚችል በጋቦን በሚገኝ ደን ላይ አተኩረው ነበር፣ ስለዚህ ቴክኖሎጂው ሌላ ቦታም ሊተገበር እንደሚችል ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
